thread:
Ashley: @auditor_acme quick Q — when you ask for an 'access patterns snapshot' do you mean RBAC change events + API access logs, or also session/IP patterns?

auditor_acme: Hi Ashley — ideally RBAC changes + API access logs for last 12 months. Session/IP heatmap is optional but useful. Also need KMS key usage records (rotations + use), and evidence logs that are immutable/retained.

Seema: We can produce RBAC change history from our audit index, Okta admin logs, and Kubernetes audit. For KMS: CloudTrail/Cloud Audit Logs export. Want raw logs or summarized CSVs?

Mike: Raw artifacts are fine. We keep daily exports at s3://redwood-compliance/archives/kms-usage/ (partitioned by date). Quick sample to list recent objects: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-compliance/archives/kms-usage/ --recursive | tail -n 20` :shipit:﻿

auditor_acme: Raw + short README describing fields would be great. Also need a statement of who can rotate keys (custody) and any HSM attestations.

Ashley: Good call. Custody group is `kms-ops` in our IAM. We'll include a signed policy excerpt and RBAC ACL snapshot. Example policy snippet internal QA: 
```json
{
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:group/kms-ops"]},"Action":["kms:RotateKey","kms:DisableKey"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```

Mike: For KMS usage queries in CloudTrail -> Athena we use this sample: 
```sql
SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName as principal, eventName, requestParameters.keyId
FROM "cloudtrail_logs".events
WHERE eventSource = 'kms.amazonaws.com' AND eventTime >= date_add('month', -12, current_date)
ORDER BY eventTime DESC
LIMIT 500;
```

Seema: For RBAC we store events in ES index `rbac-audit-*`. Sample curl to fetch bind events: `curl -s -XGET "https://es.internal/_search?q=verb:bind&size=50"` — we'll include a sanitized sample.

Ashley: On immutability: logs are exported to S3 with Object Lock (Governance mode) + CloudTrail configured with multi-region trail and digest checksums stored in `s3://redwood-compliance/digests/` for tamper evidence. We'll include the retention policy and an example digest manifest.

incident-bot: Incident created: `INC-2025-11-03-T5` — vuln CVE-2025-1234 detected, mitigation required. Affected: infra-api-role binding changed temporarily.

Mike: When mapping RBAC changes to incidents, we keep a small manifest at s3://redwood-compliance/incident-mappings/ with CSV rows like `incident_id,event_ts,es_doc_id,pr_link`. We'll export matching rows for the last 12 months.

auditor_acme: Please also include PR links for RBAC changes and approval diffs where available — that'll help verify separation of duties.

Ashley: We can run a GitHub search across `redwood/infra` for `kubectl apply` / rolebinding files and bundle PRs. Example GH query: `org:redwood repo:infra path:roles "rolebinding"` — we'll attach the PR list.

Seema: Deliverable plan: one S3 package with `manifest.json` (list of files + SHA256), `README.md` (field defs + queries), `raw_logs/` (raw exports), `queries/` (sample queries), `pr_links.csv`, and `incidents_mapping.csv`. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

auditor_acme: That sounds good. Please ensure any pre-signed URLs expire in 7 days and include contact for follow-up. Also, include a short note confirming retention policy length and Object Lock configuration.

Ashley: Will produce presigned URLs for the package (7d expiry) and include retention statement. Tagging @mike for the export job and @seema for packaging/attestation.

Mike: I'll kick off the export job this afternoon. Export steps I'll run (for reproducibility):
```bash
# export RBAC events from ES to s3
curl -s -XPOST "https://es.internal/_snapshot/s3_repo/_restore" -d '{"indices":"rbac-audit-*","ignore_unavailable":true}'
# copy snapshot to s3 bucket
aws s3 cp /tmp/es-snapshot-2025-11 s3://redwood-compliance/exports/rbac/ --recursive
# generate manifest
shasum -a 256 $(find /tmp/es-snapshot-2025-11 -type f) > /tmp/manifest.sha256
aws s3 cp /tmp/manifest.sha256 s3://redwood-compliance/exports/rbac/manifest.sha256
```

Seema: I'll draft the README and the custody attestation. Ashley — can you add the signed key policy excerpt and a one-line HSM note (we use CloudHSM-backed keys for the enterprise KMS)?

Ashley: Yep. Quick note: HSM-backed keys = CloudHSM cluster attached to our KMS for the `enterprise/*` keys. Will include attestation link to SOC report of the provider.

auditor_acme: Thanks everyone — please ping me in this thread when package is uploaded. One follow-up: do you have a sample query that shows 'who' performed a rolebinding change (user + IP + timestamp)? If yes, include that exact query and a sanitized sample output.

Mike: Sample ES query (sanitized): `POST /rbac-audit-*/_search {"query":{"bool":{"must":[{"match":{"verb":"bind"}},{"exists":{"field":"user.identity"}}]}},"size":20}` — output includes `user.identity.principal`, `source.ip`, `@timestamp`. We'll include a CSV export of a few rows.

Ashley: Great — we'll assemble and upload. ETA EOD tomorrow as noted. If anything changes I'll update timestamps here. :thumbsup:
